value.answer: There's no open Costco in Oakville yet. The first one is due in fall 2027, on Wyecroft Rd near Burloak Dr. For now the closest open ones are Burlington at 1225 Brant St, and Mississauga at 3180 Laird Rd. I didn't check drive times, so I can't say which is closer from your part of Oakville.
